head: thoughtworks/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct-Eagle3
notes: T_decode_q1: S_q=1 non-verify forward, cache grows +1/iter (~40 toks over 40 iters on 4k base, negligible). T_verify_q4: S_q=4 verify arm, add_draft re-stages sandbox without committing — repeated at same cache state. T_draft4: propose_from is non-mutating, same state reused. T_advance: re-seeded state each iter to keep m+1=4 advance at a fixed base. modeled_speedup uses mean_accepted=2.1 from Phase 12 task A 4k measurement.
